questions.question: In his letter to the church in Corinth, how did Paul say people should regard him and Apollos?
Paul told the Corinthians that his clear conscience did not prove him right. Who did he say judges him?
Paul told the Corinthians how the apostles respond when people insult them. What do the apostles do?

answers.text: They bless those who insult them
They curse those who insult them

questions.question: In his letter to the church in Corinth, why did Paul describe the hardships of the apostles?

answers.text: To warn them as his beloved children
To shame them in front of others
To prove he is the better teacher
